statement: The function returns a result r and r = min { sum_{i=0}^{n-1} cost[i] * |nums[i] - x| : x ∈ Z }, where |a| denotes the absolute value of a.
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = 0.
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6, and there exists an integer v such that for every i with 0 <= i < n, nums[i] = v.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = min(cost[0], cost[1]) * |nums[0] - nums[1]|.
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6, and n = 2.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = min { sum_{i=0}^{n-1} cost[i] * |nums[i] - nums[j]| : 0 <= j < n }.
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6.

statement: The function returns a result r and for every integer x, sum_{i=0}^{n-1} cost[i] * |nums[i] - x| >= r.
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6.

statement: The function returns a result r and there exists an integer x with min(nums) <= x <= max(nums) such that sum_{i=0}^{n-1} cost[i] * |nums[i] - x| = r, where min(nums) = min_{0<=i<n} nums[i] and max(nums) = max_{0<=i<n} nums[i].
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6.

statement: The function returns a result r and there exists an integer x such that sum_{i=0}^{n-1} cost[i] * |nums[i] - x| = r and (sum_{i: nums[i] < x} cost[i] <= (1/2) * sum_{i=0}^{n-1} cost[i]) and (sum_{i: nums[i] > x} cost[i] <= (1/2) * sum_{i=0}^{n-1} cost[i]).
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6.

statement: The function returns a result r on (nums, cost). If nums' is the slice of length n defined by nums'[i] = nums[i] + c for 0 <= i < n, then the function returns r on (nums', cost).
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6, and let c be any integer such that for all i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] + c <= 10^6.

statement: The function returns a result r on (nums, cost). For every permutation π of {0,...,n-1}, if nums' and cost' are the slices of length n defined by nums'[i] = nums[π(i)] and cost'[i] = cost[π(i)] for 0 <= i < n, then the function returns r on (nums', cost').
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6.

statement: The function returns a result r on (nums, cost). If cost' is the slice of length n defined by cost'[i] = k * cost[i] for 0 <= i < n, then the function returns k * r on (nums, cost').
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6, and let k be a positive integer such that for all i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= k * cost[i] <= 10^6.

statement: The function returns a result r on (nums, cost). For every array cost' of length n with 1 <= cost'[i] <= 10^6 for all i and cost'[i] >= cost[i] for all i with 0 <= i < n, if the function returns r' on (nums, cost'), then r' >= r.
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6.

statement: The function returns a result r and r <= sum_{i=0}^{n-1} cost[i] * |nums[i] - nums[0]|.
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6.

statement: The function returns a result r without failing (no overflow, no out-of-bounds, no panic).
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6.

statement: Let g = gcd(cost[0], cost[1], ..., cost[n-1]). The function returns a result r and r is a multiple of g.
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = 0 if and only if there exists an integer v such that for every i with 0 <= i < n, nums[i] = v.
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6.

statement: Let W = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} cost[i]. The function returns a result r and, for every integer x, sum_{i=0}^{n-1} cost[i] * |nums[i] - x| = r if and only if (sum_{i: nums[i] < x} cost[i] <= (1/2) * W and sum_{i: nums[i] > x} cost[i] <= (1/2) * W).
preconditions: len(nums) = len(cost) = n, n >= 1, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 and 1 <= cost[i] <= 10^6.
